rca of the issue: X-Frame-Options DENY on /api/lp/{slug}/render RCA — HTTP HEAD/GET on https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api/lp/iter375-seller-1784745269/render?lang=en returns header 'x-frame-options: DENY'. Chrome console logs 'Refused to display <origin>/ in a frame because it set X-Frame-Options to deny.' when the admin's lp-preview-iframe loads that URL. Verified via Playwright: document.querySelector('[data-testid="lp-preview-iframe"]').contentDocument === null (accessible=false). Impact: the Preview tab renders a blank iframe for published pages (DraftPreview via srcDoc still works). Reproduction: (1) log in as admin, (2) open any published landing page in /admin/landing-pages/{id}, (3) switch to Preview tab, (4) observe blank iframe. Mitigation: In backend, either (a) explicitly set response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = 'SAMEORIGIN' on the render route (or delete the header) — since it's rendered via Response(html, media_type='text/html'), a middleware likely injects DENY; (b) exempt /api/lp/*/render from the global X-Frame-Options middleware; (c) rely solely on CSP frame-ancestors 'self' for framing control. Header-fixing is a one-line change on the render route.
